overview.description: The Roundhill Neocloud ETF (NCLD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in companies involved in neocloud infrastructure and services for artificial intelligence and other accelerated computing workloads. The fund seeks capital appreciation. NCLD was launched on Aug 6, 2026 and is issued by Roundhill.
